Timed with its 12th anniversary, high-tech cleaning company Roborock (石頭科技) is celebrating with major discounts across its full range of robotic vacuums and other products, with deals running through September 6.

Anniversary deals cover all product lines and bundles, with savings ranging from 25% to over 50%, with some saving up to $1,600…

Saros 20

The Saros 20 pictured above is the company's flagship smart robot vacuum, featuring unprecedented real-world intelligence, designed for the spaces and complexities of large North American homes. Key features include the StarSight Autonomous Navigation System 2.0, AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0, Carpet Intelligence System, and Smart Plan 3.0 intelligent planning.

StarSight is the most advanced autonomous navigation system on the market. It combines dual-emission solid-state LiDAR with 3D time-of-flight technology to create highly detailed 3D maps of your home, reliably identifying and avoiding over 300 different obstacles—from stray cables to pets.

The AdaptiLift Chassis is an advanced system that detects thresholds and steps in rooms, then automatically lifts the Saros 20 over them using motorized legs, ensuring uninterrupted whole-home cleaning. Similarly, the Carpet Intelligence System automatically adjusts the body height to maintain optimal suction for deep cleaning even on carpets with pile lengths up to 3 cm.

Smart Plan 2.0 is an AI-powered intelligent cleaning system that analyses your home's unique layout, flooring, and each resident's habits to automatically optimize cleaning routes.

Qrevo 2 Pro

Making its U.S. debut, the all-new Qrevo 2 Pro is the ultimate robot vacuum for pet households. Purpose-built for stubborn stains and pet hair, it features a dual anti-tangle system and 20,000 Pa suction, removing 100% of hair with zero tangles. This robot handles pet dander and hair, cat litter, cereal, and muddy paw prints with ease.

The most challenging scenario is having both pets and long-pile carpets. The Qrevo Pro 2 tackles this effortlessly with auto mop removal, leaving the mop pads at the dock to ensure carpets stay completely dry.

F25 Steam

The F25 Steam is the ultimate handheld wet-dry cleaner, combining 25,000 Pa suction with 180°C (356°F) VaporFlow steam cleaning.

Key features include up to 80 minutes of whole-home cleaning runtime, a 180-degree flat design for reaching under furniture, a blue light that reveals hidden dust, and fully automatic steam self-cleaning and hot-air drying after use.

F25 XT

If you want powerful wet-dry cleaning without steam, the F25 XT delivers 20,000 Pa suction and SlideTech 2.0 wheels for a smoother, more effortless cleaning experience.

The F25 XT delivers true edge-to-edge wet-dry cleaning, delivering a perfect finish in a single pass. The JawScrapers roller brush features anti-tangle bristles with shark-tooth blades that effectively capture hair, while the continuous-pressure scraper ensures streak-free floors. It also features the F25 Steam's 180-degree flat design and offers up to 60 minutes of runtime in eco mode—enough to continuously clean up to 4,400 square feet without recharging.

More Deals

The Qrevo S Pro and two of the company's most popular bundles are also heavily discounted:

  • Qrevo S Pro: Originally $699.99, now $429.99—saving $270 (38% off)
  • Saros 20 + F25GT bundle: Originally $1,899.99, now $1,269.98—saving $630 (33% off)
  • Qrevo S Pro + F25GT bundle: Originally $999.98, now $549.98—saving $450 (45% off)

All promotional pricing ends September 6, so don't miss out.
